name: Electric steam cracking
applications: low-carbon ethylene and propylene when power is renewable
principle: The gas-fired radiant coils of a steam cracker are replaced by coils heated with electricity, so the furnace itself emits no combustion CO2. The rest of the plant (quench, compression, cryogenic separation) is unchanged, which makes the route a retrofit option for existing crackers if renewable power and grid capacity are available.

performance.metric: CO2 reduction potential versus conventional cracking
performance.basis: BASF, SABIC and Linde claim at least 90% with renewable power (potential, not measured)
